title: Critical Bi-Pyramid Rigidity, Exact 42-Bit Hypergraph Stitching over the 656 (5,5;42) Catalog, and Formal Certification of M(5,5;43) <= 2

creators.name: Yin, Zihan
creators.affiliation: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

description: Self-contained C++17 computer-assisted proof suite, zero-dependency Python 3 referee verifier, extremal graph catalogs (witness_k43_e2_catalog.txt and k42_pool_656.txt), and dependency-free Lean 4 kernel certificate (certificate_m55_43.lean) establishing: (1) the unconditional constructive Ramsey multiplicity upper bound M(5,5;43) <= 2 and exact |Aut| = 2 reflection anatomy of the two canonical critical bi-pyramids G*_1 and G*_2; (2) exact local rigidity over the 2^231 core (k=22) and 252,083,534 bounded Hamming ball states; and (3) a zero-cutoff 42-bit hypergraph stitching proof that min E_{K5}^*(G_42) = 2 across all 656 non-isomorphic oriented (5,5;42) extremal graphs.
notes: Source code is released under the MIT License; graph datasets and manuscript materials are released under CC-BY-4.0. Repository: https://github.com/00sodj/ramsey-r55-k43
